title: Recent Developments in Artificial Intelligence News
description: Industry leaders have come together to form the Open Secure AI Alliance, focusing on AI safety and security.

sources.title: Industry Leaders Unite in Open Secure AI Alliance for AI Safety and Security
Nvidia, SpaceX, Microsoft launch AI safety initiative as OpenAI cyberattack fallout continues
Anthropic’s Amodei Rejects Open Model Ban But Calls for Testing

sections.heading: Open Secure AI Alliance
paragraphs: According to the NVIDIA Blog, industry leaders have united to form the Open Secure AI Alliance, an initiative aimed at ensuring AI safety and security.

sections.heading: AI Safety Initiative
paragraphs: CNBC reports that Nvidia, SpaceX, and Microsoft have launched an AI safety initiative in response to the fallout from an OpenAI cyberattack.

sections.heading: Anthropic's Stance on AI Models
paragraphs: Bloomberg.com shares that Anthropic’s Amodei has rejected a ban on open AI models but has called for more testing.

faq.q: What is the Open Secure AI Alliance?
faq.a: The Open Secure AI Alliance is an initiative formed by industry leaders to focus on AI safety and security, as reported by the NVIDIA Blog.

faq.q: Why was the AI safety initiative launched?
faq.a: The AI safety initiative was launched as a response to the fallout from an OpenAI cyberattack, according to CNBC.

faq.q: What is Anthropic's position on open AI models?
faq.a: Anthropic’s Amodei has rejected a ban on open AI models but has called for more testing, as stated by Bloomberg.com.
